comment: Note source -> its status (canvas/note-status). The server (agent/status.rs) and the web client (objects/status.ts) both run this set. A status is declared by a `status:` key in frontmatter (closing `---` within 20 lines) or a `Status:` line among the first three non-empty lines after the opening heading; frontmatter wins. `raw` is the value as written, bold markers dropped. `kind` is decision, question or none (a word the board does not know); `expect` null means no status at all.
